result:
L1: * (/status | lower | eq "paid") | /items * (/qty * (/price | add 0 !| 0)) | sum | round 2

L2: * (/state | eq "open") * (/labels | * .) | group

L3: ((/dependencies | * (/. | starts "^0.") | keys) + (/devDependencies | * (/. | starts "^0.") | keys)) | distinct | sort

L4: /data/users | * (/active | eq true) * (/email | eq null | not) | * /email | * lower | distinct | sort

L5: /services | * ((/enabled | . !| true | eq true) * (/port | eq null | not)) | keys | * {:name /., :port (/services | /. | /port)} | sort

L6: split "\n" | * {method: (. | split " " | /1), status: (. | split " " | /3), duration: (. | split " " | /4)} | * (/method | eq "GET") | * (/status | eq "200") | * (/duration | sub "ms" "" | to_number) | average | round 1

L7: split "\n" | * (. | split "," | {:name /0, :dept /1, :salary /2}) | * ((/name | ne "name") * (/salary | ne "")) | * {:dept (/dept | lower), :salary (/salary | to_number)} | group /dept | * (avg /salary | round)

L8: * /user | group | * {user: /., count: /count} | sort | first 3 | * (/user + ":" + /count)

L9: "Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split "," | * (. | trim | lower) | distinct | sort | join "|"

L10: split "\n" | * (. | trim) | * (. | ne "") | * (. | /0 | ne "#") | * (. | contains "==") | * ({:name (. | split "==" | /0 | lower), :version (. | split "==" | /1)}) | to_object

L11: * (/state | eq "open") * (/assignee | eq null) | sort | first 2 | * /number

L12: * /customer | group | * {customer: /., count: /count} | * (/count | ge 2 | /customer) | sort

L13: /data/users | * {name: /name, country: (/address/country !| "unknown")} | group /country | * sort

L14: * (/type | eq "push") * (/payload/repo/name | eq null | not) | * /payload/repo/name | distinct | sort
